newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers offered up but buyers sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers offered up but buyers sidelined.

text.p: Singapore bunker suppliers raised their prices again on Thursday on the back of a recent spike to cargo prices and a firmer crude, traders said.

But shipowners continued to stay on the sidelines, they said. "Suppliers can hardly find buyers when prices are so high but they are unwilling to cut offers," said one trader, noting Singapore's high prices compared with other ports.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted higher at $106-109 per tonne and 380-cst was at $100-103. MDO and gas oil were at $200-$205 and $210-$220 respectively.
